data.name: Zama
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Zama was a nymph who was known for her memory and recollection. She was often invoked by poets and scholars seeking inspiration and knowledge. In Christianity, Zama is not directly referenced in the Bible, but the name carries the symbolism of remembrance and reverence for the past.
